title: RFC005 S3 Run Manifest
$comment: Closed envelope for one S3 discovery run: the identity under which it may execute (design §7.1). `run_id` is derived from every other field (addendum A, the same construction s1_run_manifest / s2_run_manifest use). S3 has no run-manifest shape of its own for cache identity, allowlist or ancestry -- those bindings are carried by naming a companion S1-format run manifest by hash, exactly as s2_run_manifest does. `typed_integer_codec` is pinned `direct_regression` (D5); `grad_clip_micro` deliberately does NOT appear here -- it lives only in run_config.json (design §7.1, [governance R1]).

run_id.$comment: make_id("s3run", "rfc005.s3-run-id/v1", payload without run_id and without the self-hash). Derived, never assigned.

run_seed.$comment: The seed the ordered exposure plan (reused from S2) was built under.

binding_s1_run_manifest_hash.$comment: The companion S1-format run manifest's own s1_run_manifest_hash, re-derived by the builder from the presented companion document -- never a caller-typed value.

typed_supervision_census_hash.$comment: The frozen s3_typed_census.json's own census_hash, re-derived by the builder from the presented document.

heads_frozen_for_no_supervision.$comment: Explicit, may be empty. A head listed here whose census family-bearing supervised count is at or above min_supervised_per_head is an unused freeze and is refused by the builder (DEC-027 D2 rule).

lr_reduced_micro.$comment: Integer thousandths of the reduced learning rate applied to tree_text_decoder (house style: lr_micro).

init_from.$comment: Warm-start pin (design §6) or null for a clean run. parent_run_class is never caller-supplied at admission: it is re-derived here from the presented parent companion manifest, whose own hash must equal parent_s1_run_manifest_hash.
